# Accordion: `jl-accordion`

A list of sections that open under their headings, one at a time or several.

- Class `JlAccordion`, a molecule: `import { JlAccordion } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/accordion

A list of jl-accordion-item sections under their headings. By default one item opens at a time:
opening one closes the others, which keeps a long list short. Set multiple to let several stay open, for content
people compare.

plain separates the items with lines on the page; bordered puts them in a box. Each item is a native details element,
so its heading works with the keyboard and screen readers, and the browser's find-in-page opens it.

## Use

```ts
import { JlAccordion, JlAccordionItem } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlAccordion variant="bordered">
  <JlAccordionItem heading="Can I change my plan later?" open>
    Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time; the difference is prorated on your next invoice.
  </JlAccordionItem>
  <JlAccordionItem heading="Do you offer a free trial?">
    Every plan starts with 14 days free, no card needed.
  </JlAccordionItem>
  <JlAccordionItem heading="How do I cancel?">
    From Settings, Billing: the plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for.
  </JlAccordionItem>
</JlAccordion>
```

```html
<jl-accordion variant="bordered">
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Can I change my plan later?" open>
    Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time; the difference is prorated on your next invoice.
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Do you offer a free trial?">
    Every plan starts with 14 days free, no card needed.
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="How do I cancel?">
    From Settings, Billing: the plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for.
  </jl-accordion-item>
</jl-accordion>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `multiple` (attribute `multiple`): `boolean`, default `false`. Lets several items stay open together; otherwise opening one closes the others.
- `variant` (attribute `variant`): `'plain' | 'bordered'`, default `'plain'`. Lines between the items on the page, or the items in a box.

## Slots

- The default slot: The jl-accordion-item elements.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The box around the items.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Plain

One item open at a time: opening another closes it.

```html
<jl-accordion class="narrow">
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Can I change my plan later?" open>
    Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time; the difference is prorated on your next invoice.
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Do you offer a free trial?">
    Every plan starts with 14 days free, no card needed.
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="How do I cancel?">
    From Settings, Billing: the plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for.
  </jl-accordion-item>
</jl-accordion>
```

### Bordered, several open

In a box, lines between the items; multiple lets several stay open.

```html
<jl-accordion variant="bordered" multiple class="narrow">
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Profile" icon="user" open>
    <p class="muted">Your name, photo and the email people see.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Notifications" icon="bell" open>
    <p class="muted">Email for mentions and replies; a daily digest for the rest.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Security" icon="shield-check">
    <p class="muted">Two-step sign-in is on. Last sign-in yesterday from Lausanne.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Billing" icon="credit-card" disabled>
    <p class="muted">Only owners manage the billing.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
</jl-accordion>
```

### Settings sections

Any content fits in an item: fields and buttons for a settings page.

```html
<jl-accordion variant="bordered" class="narrow">
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Domain" icon="globe" open>
    <div class="stack">
      <jl-input label="Domain" value="docs.example.com"></jl-input>
      <div class="row"><jl-button variant="primary" size="sm" label="Save"></jl-button></div>
    </div>
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Danger zone" icon="triangle-alert">
    <div class="stack">
      <p class="muted">Deleting the site removes its pages and its history.</p>
      <div class="row"><jl-button variant="danger" size="sm" icon="trash" label="Delete the site"></jl-button></div>
    </div>
  </jl-accordion-item>
</jl-accordion>
```
